name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.multiple.SpeechVoiceMultiplePrimaryLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK uses this page for a multi-step advertiser offer. It shows the reward amount, task instructions, and progress as the user completes the offer.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this offer flow from opening, so users cannot complete the associated ad task or receive its reward.
